name: BATTLE ART VOXEL FORK - TEST49 Select Camera Crash Fix
description: Battle Art build for Gen1Recomp 0.2.53. TEST49 preserves TEST48's Select/Back camera ladder, TEST47's supported city sapling and all approved visual, cave, battle-camera, capture/audio, Poké Ball, granite-pillar, sign and world-prop work. It removes the optional logger dependency that crashed after a camera step, so Select/Back safely cycles 15, 35, 50 and 75 degree tilts, first person, third person and off during normal overworld gameplay.
